Tomato___Early_blight.cause: Fungal infection (Alternaria solani), spreads in warm humid conditions.
Tomato___Early_blight.treatment: Remove and destroy infected leaves. Apply a copper-based fungicide. Avoid overhead watering.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Rotate crops yearly. Ensure adequate spacing between plants for airflow.

Maize___Common_rust.cause: Fungal pathogen (Puccinia sorghi), spreads via airborne spores.
Maize___Common_rust.treatment: Apply fungicide at early symptom onset. Remove severely infected plants.
Maize___Common_rust.prevention: Plant rust-resistant maize varieties where available. Avoid dense planting.
